text: The National Seismic Hazard Assessment of Papua New Guinea (NSHA-PNG) and the National Probabilistic Seismic Hazard Assessment for Papua New Guinea (2019 Revision, PSHA19) are initiatives led by Geoscience Australia to provide updated seismic hazard estimates for PNG. These initiatives aim to modernize earthquake design actions by integrating contemporary hazard science into building standards. The Interim Amendment to PNGS 1001-1982: Part 4 updates design hazard levels and introduces modern loading approaches, aligning with practices in Australia and New Zealand. This effort is supported by stakeholder engagement, in-country training, and open technical documentation to ensure safer construction practices in PNG.
